rows.preCondition: Roster state widget page is opened.
rows.testSteps:
Open the roster state widget page.
Select the three schools used in the roster flow.
Verify the roster controls become visible.
rows.expectedResult: Roster controls appear after the schools are selected.

rows.preCondition: Roster controls are visible after school selection.
rows.scenario: Printing and downloading the roster works
rows.testSteps:
Open the roster state widget page.
Select the required schools.
Sort by Class.
Click Print Roster.
Download the roster as CSV.
rows.expectedResult: Print action is available and the CSV download succeeds.

rows.preCondition: Roster controls are visible after school selection.
rows.scenario: Sorting by player columns stays usable
rows.testSteps:
Open the roster state widget page.
Select the required schools.
Click jersey, lastName, and firstName sort buttons twice each.
rows.expectedResult: Sorting controls respond without errors and remain usable.

rows.preCondition: Roster controls are visible after school selection.
rows.testSteps:
